Compared with the previous pin surface, spiral nails would reduce the size of packaging. Full-wave simulations of different packaging were carried out.

articleTitle: Detection probability analysis of airborne radar for marine target
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The method of airborne radar searching for marine target has the virtue of fast speed, working day and night, and little effecting by the sea. But it is difficult to determine the detection probability analysis of airborne radar searching for marine target because of target characteristics, environmental factors and search methods. Generally through the repeated search to improve the target detection probability, it is limited to the application of detection technology of airborne radar. This paper analyzes the basic theory of airborne radar searching for marine target, and established a research model of the way of using for typical tasks to calculate and estimate the detection ability of marine target. The paper finally gives the detection probability calculation results and provides a reference for the technology application of airborne radar searching for marine target.

articleTitle: The minimum interference distance of earth station on board vessel communicating with FSS satellite in C and Ku Band
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The minimum acceptable offshore distance is analyzed in this paper, beyond which the earth stations on board vessels (ESVs) in the frequency bands 5925–6425 MHz (C band) and 14–14.5 GHz (Ku band) will not interfere with terrestrial fixed service (FS) systems. The improved method to use in determination of a minimum offshore distance is based on the ITU-R Recommendation SF.1650-1 with the current ESV technologies and technical characteristics that are being or planned to be used. The calculation results or the ESV operational constraints can provide administrative and technical considerations in order to ensure the protection and future growth of the FS.

articleTitle: Research on the interference mechanism & radiated characteristic of EFT/B
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: According to the mathematical expression recommended by IEC 61000-4-4 2012, this paper analyzed the interference mechanism of EFT/B both in time and frequency domain. The radiated field strength was evaluated by the transient electromagnetic field measurement system based on optical fiber transmission. The distribution of the maximum field strength is presented along the plane of clamp in horizon direction (0~200cm) and vertical direction (0~50cm) at the point 50cm and 100cm. The measurement results are analyzed and some distorted waveforms and data were eliminated.

articleTitle: A non-cooperative localization scheme with unknown transmission power and path-loss exponent
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: Localization is now a vital issue widely applied in many applications. Received signal strength (RSS) based localization scheme is of great importance due to its simplicity and low cost features. However, conventional RSS based scheme under the path loss model requires calibration of path loss exponent and the source transmission power, which calls for additional hardware and software. Still, the target has to take a cooperative attitude towards localization, which is not practical for target like the source of interference. In this paper, we consider a non-cooperative localization problem without prior knowledge about the transmission power of the source and the path loss exponent. Therefore, we propose a novel least square (LS) based curve fitting approach to realize target localization. The key idea is that no extra hardware or interaction from the target is needed. Moreover, the impact of obstacles in the sensing fields is also analyzed. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A GPU-based implementation of PKF for INS/CNS integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: By using navigation system, carrier arrives at a predetermined position follow the route within the stipulated time. INS (Inertial Navigation System) has disadvantage of navigation error accumulate with time. CNS (Celestial Navigation System)'s has a low data update but the navigation error does not accumulate with time. Our goal is to develop a high-precision and high-performance navigation system by using integrated navigation method and Parallel Kalman Filter (PKF). As GPU (graphic processor units) have shown to provide much speedup in matrix computing which can be used on the filter algorithm of integrated navigation system, we will explore in this work for system performance optimization. Experiments results demonstrated that proposed solutions by using GPU accelerated Kalman filter has a scalable speedup as the measurement dimension increases than a pure CPU counterpart.

articleTitle: Effective multi-path suppression in the planar near-field measurements via the applications of matrix pencil technique
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: This paper implements and examines the signal process technique in a hybrid antenna measurement facility, which has a function to conduct a planar near field scan. Especially the matrix pencil method is adopted in this work.

articleTitle: The research of the frequency interference analysis method for Aerospace TT&C system
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The Aerospace TT&C system frequency resources are very limited. The coordination of the satellite networks is important. The Interference analysis is the basis of the satellite networks coordination. According to the Aerospace TT&C system features, the interference analytical methods are proposed which applied to GSO to GSO satellites, GSO to NGSO satellites, NGSO to NGSO satellites. Years of practical experience shows the methods are correct.

articleTitle: Ultra-thin polarization-insensitive metamaterial triple bandpass filter with high quality-factors
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: An ultra-thin metamaterial triple bandpass filter with high quality-factors is presented. This proposed structure consists of a periodic array of three concentric circle ring resonators at the top layer and a metallic mesh at the bottom layer, which are separated by a thin dielectric substrate. The investigations on the distribution of the electromagnetic field and surface current are made for explaining the filtering mechanism. The structure is also demonstrated to be flexibly and independently tunable of the pass-band resonance frequencies. Moreover, this simple structure with ultra-thin thickness is also a symmetric design which is insensitive to the polarization and incident angles. Experimental measurement of the manufactured sample show good agreement with the numerical simulations. Therefore, such a metamaterial triple bandpass filter is of great importance in some practical applications.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of MAC and PHY of a Sub-GHz wireless transmission protocol using software defined radio platform
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: Sub-GHz gets more attention in the past few years due to unlicensed ubiquitous access in less-interfered frequency band and longer diffraction distance than 2.4 GHz utilized by Zigbee and Wifi. This paper presents the design and implementation of MAC and PHY of a wireless transmission protocol based on Sub-GHz called Micro-Power Wireless Data Transmission Protocol (MPWDTP) with software defined radio (SDR) of LabVIEW on Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP). The MAC is realized in C language via state machine and the C code is converted into LabVIEW code. The PHY is implemented in LabVIEW directly and the USRP is configured according to the protocol as the frontend of radio frequency (RF). Based on MPWDTP, the point-to-point topology about power consumption and GFSK demodulator bit error rate (BER) is simulated and the simulation results show that the power consumption of point-to-point topology with a distance of 10 meters tends to be stable at 350 uJ over time and the BER of the GFSK demodulator is 10-3 when the Eb/N0 is 8.51 dB. The validity of the designed MAC and PHY is verified by the SDR experimental platform.

articleTitle: Synchronization method for logging telemetry based on OFDM
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The application of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing to logging telemetry can obtain high data transmission rate. The problem of synchronization is the key to the performance of the telemetry system. The process includes the clock synchronization, symbol synchronization and frame synchronization. For the logging telemetry, the down hole transmission clock is drift with the temperature and environment changing, the surface system must acquire and track the clock. In this thesis, we propose the method of inserting pilot frequency to obtain and track the surface system frequency, and use the pseudo random sequence to achieve symbol synchronization. This algorithm has the advantages of less computation, fast convergence and so on. It has been used in the sets of logging equipment. The establishing time is short and training result is in good agreement.

articleTitle: UTD-type decomposition employed to interpret the scattering mechanisms of reflectarray antenna
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The radar cross section (RCS) of a reflectarray antenna is investigated. The reflectarray antenna is assumed to radiate fields focused in the far zone. The RCS is determined when this reflectarray antenna is illuminated by an incident plane wave. The study focuses on the RCS of the reflectarray with that of feed antenna excluded for simplification. In particular, the UTD-type decomposition is employed to interpret the scattering mechanisms, which allows one to justify the significance of each scattering mechanism. Theoretical development will be presented to illustrate the scattering mechanisms.

articleTitle: Analysis of crosstalk between cables on board in high speed EMUs
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: Due to intensive cable arrangement in high speed EMUs, the work on crosstalk coupling between power lines to temperature sensor lines with groove is quite important. According to a specific cable arrangement on board in EMU, this paper deals with the influence of structure of groove, intersection angle and impedance of lines by electromagnetic simulation software which was based on Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD). In the light of actual situation, using 110V sinusoidal voltage as excitation source of power line. The results suggested that the metal structure of groove can reduce the maximum crosstalk 13dB, the cover and clapboard of groove can also reduce some crosstalk. In addition, the crosstalk value declines with the intersection angle increased and impedance of cables decreased.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic shielding performance of steel truss bridge in multi-track electrified railway
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the electromagnetic shielding performance of the steel truss bridge in electrified railway. The background of the study is based on the AC and DC railway systems which are running in parallel in the project of Dashengguan Bridge. The multi-conductors model including the steel truss bridge as well as the of the conductors of traction supply systems are constructed by the Q3D software. After that, the electrostatic voltage, induction electromotive force with and without the influence of steel truss bridge has been computed. By comparing the result under two distinct conditions, the electromagnetic shielding performance of the steel truss bridge can be evaluated.

articleTitle: VPX based spaceborne SAR real-time echo simulation
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: To perform the spaceborne Synthetic Aperture Radar(SAR) system ground test, an echo simulator with multimode, multi-assemblage, and real-time is proposed in this paper. With the platform of the real-time simulator based on FPGA and VPX bus, real-time, multi-point echo generation and scenario targets echo generation can be achieved, while the parameters are calculated by the industry computers. Furthermore, different signals can be output in this platform if the platform is expanded to multi-channels. It is possible for the assignment of echo generation and test in different spaceborne SAR modes. The test results of the platform show that the platform can satisfy the system requirements and it is used in practice.

articleTitle: Quantifying the availability of TV white spaces for cognitive LTE systems in China
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The explosive growth of capacity-hungry wireless services are presenting challenges to the scarce spectrum resource. Operating LTE systems on TV white space may meet the capacity demand due to the good propagation characteristic. However, according to the decision on World Radiocommunication Conference 2012, TV white space is unable to be used by LTE systems exclusively in the near further in China. Cognitive technologies throw light on sharing TV white space between LTE and TV broadcasting systems. Taking 470- 806 MHz band as an example, the availability of deploying LTE systems on TV white spaces in China is studied in this paper. Firstly, the separation distance from LTE stations to the edge of TV coverage area is calculated. Then, the inter-site distance between TV and LTE stations are figured out using the separation distance and TV coverage radius. Combining the theoretical calculation with the deployment information of both analog and digital TV stations stored in the national station database, simulation results on the capacity distribution of cognitive LTE system in typical cities are given. The simulation results inferred that approximately 67% of TV channels are unused averaged over the cities. This result confirms quantitatively the often-stated expectation that white spaces can be shared by LTE systems to meet the capacity demand as well as improve the spectrum efficiency.

articleTitle: Simulation and performance analysis on periodic frame generation algorithm under finite buffer in AOS
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The frame generation process, used as the first stage of the two-stage multiplexing mechanism of the advanced orbiting system (AOS), affects the transmission efficiency and time delay characteristic in performance. However, in the existing study related to the frame generation technology, the satellite-borne buffer size limits the eleven main issues, this article performs performance analysis on periodic frame generation algorithm in AOS on this basis, deriving the computational formula of buffer overflow probability and the mean value of multiplexing efficiency of packet, performing the simulation experiment and verifying the correctness of theoretical derivation. Its result can provide guidance for engineering design.

articleTitle: Dynamic composite scattering from low altitude target over sea surface
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The theoretical and experimental analyses are carried out to investigate the features of the composite scattered field. The reduced-order electric-magnetic current iteration method is proposed to rapidly calculate composite scattering of a target over sea surface. The computation of the surface current radiation integral is accelerated by the fast far field approximation algorithm (FaFFA) with adaptive grouping. Experiments with pulse-Doppler dynamic measurement system are conducted to validate the proposed method. Moreover, the pulse width of the receiver channel is determined based on the multipath effect, and thus the echo signal from the target in the presence of the sea surface can be extracted. It is of great benefit to detect low altitude targets over sea background using the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of rectangular microstrip antenna using theory of characteristic modes
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: In this paper, the rectangular microstrip antenna is analyzed by using the theory of characteristic modes (TCM). Characteristic modes of microstrip antennas with different shapes of ground are presented to provide physical understanding of the radiating behavior. The microstrip antennas operated at different modes are verified by both HFSS simulated and measured results. Resonance frequency, near field, eigencurrent, radiation pattern are analyzed and compared. The results show that some modes which similar to that obtained by cavity model could be carried out. The error of resonance frequencies of these modes predicted by TCM and cavity model is less than 2%. It is demonstrated that they are conventional TM modes.

articleTitle: Reradiation interference of high voltage transmission line to shortwave radio direction finding station
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: Based on the mechanism of passive interference, established the model of reradiation interference of high voltage transmission line to the shortwave radio direction finding station. By analyzing the effects of reradiation interference on the shortwave radio direction finding station, provide references for modifying the measured incident wave direction, and make it possible to construct novel shortwave radio direction finding stations which don't require so strict electromagnetic environment as before.

articleTitle: Studies and analysis on unintentional electromagnetic radiation of UAV
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: This paper makes a test of the near field of the unmanned aerial vehicle's (UAV) radiation at the semi-anechoic chamber and analyses the characteristic of the UAV's radiation and the band of the radiation. A electric short dipole charges' near field is simulated and analyzed. At last, this paper tests the UAV's near field at the open area test side, and obtains the distribution of magnetic field. The greatest distance of the radiation is obtained by analyzing the results.

articleTitle: Improving SNR estimation for linearly modulated signals over SIMO channels via oversampling
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: It is important to accurately estimate the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) without the a priori knowledge of modulation type and transmitted symbols in certain particular areas of communications. In this paper, we introduce the idea of oversampling and propose two novel families of second-order and fourth-order statistics based estimators. It is shown by Monte Carlo simulations that both the two families of SNR estimators clearly outperform the typical estimator in [7] and are robust to phase and synchronization uncertainty. The fourth-order statistic based estimators also show robustness to large frequency offset. The superiority and feasibility of the proposed estimators makes them suitable to be exploited in non-cooperative communications.

articleTitle: Design of a broadband end-fire antenna at P band
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband beam end-fire antenna at P-band is designed. On the basis of traditional yagi antenna, this kind antenna can reduce the original dipole to half of its former size; it also places the monopoles on the metal plate and improve the reflector and directors of this antenna moreover. This kind of antenna successfully expands the bandwidth to 38.4% at the sacrifice of deterioration of pattern through the simulation optimization of antenna parameters, which at the same time ensure the high gain in the relatively frequency band. The simulation results indicate that the antenna can implement the well radiation between the frequency band of 0.5 GHz and 0.8GHz, ensure the return loss to be under -10dB, and the direction coefficient of the plate end-fire antenna in the whole band are above 8.6 dBi.

articleTitle: A novel codeword grouped SCMA
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: In the future 5G, the fast-growing requirements of massive connectivity, higher data-rate transmissions and multiple services should be matched with new multiple access technology. Non-orthogonal multiple access, nowadays, is considered as an effective method to solve those problems. Some non-orthogonal multiple access technologies, e.g. low density signature (LDS) and sparse code multiple access (SCMA), are proposed nowadays for substantial connectivity together with spectrum efficiency promotion. Instead of spreading data symbols over orthogonal or near orthogonal code sequences in CDMA, those non-orthogonal multiple access technologies take advantage of non-orthogonal code sequences. The LDS repeatedly spreads quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) symbol according to the low density sequence, while the SCMA assigns different predefined codebooks to multiple layers. However, the SCMA codebooks made from multi-dimensional constellations are designed under the condition of same modulation order for each layer. The design scheme of SCMA codebook is regardless of the orthogonality among some certain layers. A novel codeword grouped SCMA (CG-SCMA) proposed in this paper allows diverse modulations and enhances the applicability of the non-orthogonal multiple access technology. Instead of mapping incoming bits to multi-dimensional codewords from predefined codebooks in SCMA, the procedure of symbols to complex codewords is divided into two steps: grouped indicator sequence spread and grouped symbol sequence rotation. The grouped symbol sequence rotation decreases the interference among layers and increases the signal space diversity, which is regarded as the main source of performance promotion. Simulation results are presented to show the significant performance gain of CG-SCMA comparing with SCMA and LDS.

articleTitle: Performance analysis on synchronous control of Da-Qin heavy-haul railway locomotives
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The key to safe operation of heavy-haul combined train is whether the train can be operated and controlled synchronously. In this paper, the model of GSM-R wireless transmission system on Datong-Qinhuangdao (Da-Qin for short in the following paper)heavy-haul railway and failure and recovery model are established based on DSPN. The result of simulation by TimeNet4.0 shows that the probability of data transmission delay less than 1s under Da-Qin railway wireless transmission system can meet the requirement of QoS. We analyze the influence in transmission from the operating speed. Under the assumption that two-way transmission of brake wave has the same speed and neglect the impact on brake wave velocity caused by the air load difference of locomotive. The transmission of the brake signal can also meet the safe operation of heavy-haul train.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation, and EMC Technologies (MAPE)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: antennas; electromagnetic wave propagation; EMC technology; radar; LTE system; wireless communication systems; Global Positioning System; wireless transmission protocol; OFDM; electromagnetic interference environment; zeroth-order resonator; EMU radiation emission; electromagnetic shielding effectiveness measurement; electromagnetic launcher; metamaterial designs; ultrawideband bandpass filter; UHF RFID test system; anti-radiation CMOS integrated circuits; power divider; and square electromagnetic cloak.
